rule_text: You must provide an internal grievance redressal mechanism for data principals before they escalate to the BDPA.
rule_text_technical: Data principals have the right to grievance redressal through the data fiduciary's internal mechanism before escalating to the BDPA.

first_instance.law_name: Personal Data Protection Ordinance 2025 (Bangladesh)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Bangladesh Personal Data Protection Ordinance (Bangladesh, 2025-10-01).

rule_text: You must retain copies of certain categories of sensitive personal data on servers located in Bangladesh as specified by the BDPA.
rule_text_technical: Sensitive personal data and data processed by significant data fiduciaries is subject to stricter transfer controls. Certain categories of sensitive data may be subject to a data localization requirement, meaning copies must be retained on servers located in Bangladesh, with the BDPA empowered to issue regulations specifying categories subject to localization.

first_instance.law_name: Personal Data Protection Ordinance 2025 (Bangladesh)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Bangladesh Personal Data Protection Ordinance (Bangladesh, 2025-10-01).

rule_text: A Data Protection Appellate Tribunal is established to hear appeals against BDPA decisions.
rule_text_technical: The Ordinance establishes a Data Protection Appellate Tribunal to hear appeals against BDPA decisions.

first_instance.law_name: Personal Data Protection Ordinance 2025 (Bangladesh)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Bangladesh Personal Data Protection Ordinance (Bangladesh, 2025-10-01).

rule_text: The independent data protection authority must serve as the market surveillance and enforcement body for AI systems that violate core prohibitions on high-risk practices.
rule_text_technical: The Data Protection Ombudsman supervises, as market surveillance authority, compliance with the prohibited AI practices set out in Article 5 of the AI Act.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: Competent sectoral authorities supervise transparency compliance for high-risk AI systems, while a designated communications regulator supervises transparency compliance for all other AI applications.
rule_text_technical: Traficom acts as market surveillance authority over Article 50 transparency obligations; however, for providers and deployers of high-risk AI systems, the competent authority under § 3 supervises Article 50 compliance.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: The single point of contact has the right, notwithstanding secrecy provisions, to receive information necessary to perform its tasks from market surveillance authorities and the sanctions board, and may disclose necessary information to the European Commission.
rule_text_technical: Notwithstanding confidentiality rules, the single point of contact may obtain free of charge from market surveillance authorities and the AI sanctions board information necessary for its statutory tasks, and may transmit such information to the European Commission.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: The financial regulator must notify the central bank when taking supervisory action on artificial intelligence systems.
rule_text_technical: The Financial Supervisory Authority is the notifying authority to the European Central Bank within the meaning of the second subparagraph of Article 74(7) of the AI Act.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: Personnel of notified bodies and their subcontractors are subject to criminal liability for acts in office when performing public administrative tasks, and damages liability is governed by the Tort Liability Act.
rule_text_technical: Persons employed by a notified body or its subcontractor are subject to provisions on criminal liability for acts in office when performing public administrative tasks under Articles 34, 44, and 45 of the AI Act; damages liability is governed by the Tort Liability Act (412/1974).

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: The Data Protection Ombudsman acts as the notified body when law enforcement, immigration, or asylum authorities intend to deploy a high-risk AI system referred to in Annex III(1) of the AI Act.
rule_text_technical: The Data Protection Ombudsman serves as notified body where law enforcement, immigration, or asylum authorities intend to put into service an Annex III(1) high-risk AI system; § 9(1) and § 10(2) do not apply to the Ombudsman in that role.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: An AI Sanctions Board operates in connection with Traficom and decides on administrative fines under this Act on the basis of a proposal from the competent market surveillance authority.
rule_text_technical: The AI Systems Supervision Sanctions Board, attached to Traficom, imposes administrative fines under this Act upon proposal of the competent market surveillance authority; it may impose the fine as proposed, lower or higher, or refrain from imposing it.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: Members of the Sanctions Board must be civil servants with expertise in AI systems and relevant law, must serve a three-year term, and must act independently and impartially.
rule_text_technical: Sanctions Board members and deputies must be civil servants with expertise in AI systems, related legislation, and supervision in the appointing authority's field; the chair and deputy chair must additionally have sufficient legal expertise; members are appointed for three-year terms and act independently and impartially.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: As an authorised representative of a high-risk AI system provider, you must verify the EU declaration of conformity and technical documentation are drawn up, that conformity assessment was carried out, retain documentation for 10 years, supply information on request, and ensure registration under Article 49.
rule_text_technical: An administrative fine may be imposed on an authorised representative who intentionally or negligently breaches Article 22 duties: ensuring the EU declaration of conformity and Article 11 technical documentation are drawn up; ensuring the provider conducted Article 43 conformity assessment; keeping documentation available to authorities for 10 years; supplying information on reasoned request (subject to the criminal-suspicion exception); and registering the system under Article 49(1) or verifying registration data.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: As an importer of a high-risk AI system, you must verify conformity assessment, technical documentation, EU declaration of conformity, CE marking, instructions for use, and the appointment of an authorised representative; not place non-conforming systems on the market; report risks; identify yourself; protect the system during storage/transport; retain documents for 10 years; and supply information on request.
rule_text_technical: An administrative fine may be imposed on an importer who intentionally or negligently breaches Article 23 obligations including verifying conformity assessment, technical documentation, declaration of conformity and CE marking, instructions for use, the third-country provider's authorised representative, refraining from placing non-conforming or counterfeit systems on the market, notifying provider/representative/authority of Article 79(1) risks, indicating identification details on the system, ensuring storage and transport conditions do not jeopardise conformity, retaining the EU declaration and notified-body certificate for 10 years, and supplying requested information (subject to the criminal-suspicion exception).

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: As a distributor of a high-risk AI system, you must verify that the system meets applicable conformity standards, ensure that users receive clear instructions for proper use, prevent non-conforming systems from reaching the market, maintain appropriate storage and transport conditions, take corrective action when safety or performance issues arise, and provide regulatory authorities with requested information about the system.
rule_text_technical: An administrative fine may be imposed on a distributor who intentionally or negligently breaches Article 24 obligations including verifying CE marking and EU declaration of conformity, verifying instructions for use, refraining from making non-conforming systems available, ensuring storage and transport conditions, taking Article 24(4) corrective measures where the system is non-conforming or poses an Article 79(1) risk, and supplying information on reasoned request (subject to the criminal-suspicion exception).

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: You must maintain records of all subcontractors for five years, obtain explicit consent before subcontracting conformity assessment work, verify that high-risk AI systems meet applicable safety and performance standards, and promptly provide requested information to regulatory authorities; failure to do so may result in financial penalties.
rule_text_technical: An administrative fine may be imposed on a notified body that intentionally or negligently fails to comply with Article 31 requirements, subcontracts or assigns to a subsidiary without the provider's agreement contrary to Article 33(3), fails to retain documents on subcontractor competence assessment and activities for five years per Article 33(4), fails to carry out conformity assessments under Article 34(1) and Article 43, or fails to supply requested information to the notifying authority under Article 34(3) (subject to the criminal-suspicion exception).

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: You may be fined for intentionally or negligently providing incorrect, incomplete, or misleading information to a notified body or market surveillance authority, except where the natural person is reasonably suspected of a crime to which the information relates.
rule_text_technical: An administrative fine may be imposed on operators or notified bodies who intentionally or negligently supply incorrect, incomplete, or misleading information in response to a request from a notified body, market surveillance authority, or notifying authority; the fine cannot be imposed on a natural person reasonably suspected of a crime where the information relates to that suspicion.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: As a deployer of an emotion recognition or biometric categorisation system, you must inform natural persons exposed to it of its operation.
rule_text_technical: An administrative fine may be imposed on a deployer who intentionally or negligently breaches the Article 50(3) obligation to inform natural persons exposed to an emotion recognition system or biometric categorisation system of its operation.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: A fine cannot be imposed on a person who is being investigated, prosecuted, or tried for the same act in a criminal proceeding, or who has received a final judgment for the same act.
rule_text_technical: No administrative fine may be imposed on a person who is suspected of the same act in pre-trial investigation, prosecutorial consideration, or pending criminal proceedings, or who has received a final criminal judgment for the same act.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: A periodic penalty payment cannot be imposed to enforce information obligations under Articles 21(1), 22(3)(c), 23(6), or 24(5) of the AI Act against a natural person reasonably suspected of a crime where the information relates to that suspicion.
rule_text_technical: A conditional fine may not be imposed to enforce information-disclosure obligations under Articles 21(1), 22(3)(c), 23(6), and 24(5) of the AI Act against a natural person reasonably suspected of a crime where the information requested relates to the matter under criminal suspicion.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).

rule_text: Sanctions for prohibited AI practices do not apply to breaches that occurred before the law's effective date.
rule_text_technical: § 21 shall not apply to violations or omissions of prohibited AI practices that occurred before the entry into force of the Act on 1 January 2026.

first_instance.law_name: Laki eräiden tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnasta (Act on the Supervision of Certain AI Systems)

instances.notes: Rule introduced in Finland AI Supervision Act 2025 (Finland, 2025-12-22).
